title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut Desktop with AI Extend to keep extending a finished…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut Desktop with AI Extend to keep extending a finished clip and continue the story beyond the original ending.  
Download the official opening video from the challenge site and use it as your first scene before generating additional scenes with CapCut’s AI Video/AI Edit/AI Extend.  
Make your final video 3 minutes or longer by chaining AI Extend (and additional AI-generated scenes) to build out the narrative.
